tools.name: get_v1_number_check
tools.description: Whether a phone number has a WhatsApp account, and its WhatsApp id. A number without an account is a normal answer (`registered: false`), not an error. Group: Numbers. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_v1_group_invite
tools.description: What WhatsApp shows anyone who opens a group's invite link: the group's name (`subject`) and description with who set them and when, its size, creation time and creator's country, its settings (announcements only, admin-only edits, join approval), the owner, and a few participants with their phone n

tools.name: get_v1_channel
tools.description: A WhatsApp channel by its invite link or code: name, description, follower count (`channelMetadata.size`), verification, creation time and settings. Looking does not follow the channel. Group: Channels. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

tools.name: get_v1_channel_messages
tools.description: The latest posts of a WhatsApp channel, newest last, with their text, type, time, links and whether they carry media. Does not follow the channel. Group: Channels. Billing per call: 2 Credits.

tools.name: get_v1_channels_search
tools.description: WhatsApp's channel directory: channels whose name matches `query`, in the countries asked for, or without a query the directory's recommended, trending, popular or new channels. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "whatsapp-wyjbao" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_v1_number_profile, get_v1_channel_messages, get_v1_channels_search · Private data: get_v1_number_profile · Public sink: get_v1_number_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_v1_number_profile, get_v1_channel_messages, get_v1_channels_search · Private data: get_v1_number_profile · Public sink: get_v1_number_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
